We meet in homes.

Hope Endtime Church in Masakla gathers every Saturday, moving from one family’s home to the next.

Join this SaturdaySend a prayer request

Saturday fellowship, house to house

We do not meet in one building. Each week the fellowship goes to a different home in Masakla, and everyone is welcome to come. Call Pastor Kennedy to ask which home we are meeting at and what time to arrive.

Call 0117 970 378WhatsApp

What we hold to

We watch

The Lord told us to stay awake. We read the Word and the times with clear eyes, without fear and without hype.

Matthew 24:42

We pray

Prayer is the work of this church. We pray for one another, for our children and for peace in Kenya.

1 Thessalonians 5:17

We stay ready

Ready means a clean heart and a life that matches what we sing together.

Luke 12:35

We serve Masakla

We visit the sick, welcome the stranger and stand with families who are struggling.

Galatians 6:10

Our needs

We are a small village church and there is work still to be done. These are the things we are praying for.

🎹

Musical instruments

Instruments to help us lead worship.

💡

Electricity

Power for light and sound where we gather.

🎨

Church painting

Fresh paint for our church building.

💧

Water tanks

Tanks to store clean water for the church.

➕
